headerDisplay: Exposes air quality data from InPost Paczkomat parcel-locker sensors in Poland as HomeKit accessories. The plugin uses an unofficial (undocumented) InPost endpoint and may break if InPost changes their site.
footerDisplay: Find locker codes (e.g. ABC01A) in the InPost app or on inpost.pl. Exposure toggles apply after a Homebridge restart; disabling one removes the corresponding HomeKit tile/data. Logs always show the full payload from the unit.

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Leave empty to identify honestly as homebridge-inpost-air. Set to 'browser' to mimic a Chrome User-Agent (may help or hurt against anti-bot protection).

showPM.title: Show PM2.5/PM10 density
showPM.description: Show PM2.5/PM10 density inside the Air Quality sensor. Uncheck to hide.

showGases.title: Show NO2/O3 density
showGases.description: Show NO2/O3 density inside the Air Quality sensor (only units that report gases). Uncheck to hide.

showTemperature.title: Show Temperature sensor
showTemperature.description: Expose a linked Temperature tile (populated on units that report temperature). Uncheck to remove it.

showHumidity.title: Show Humidity sensor
showHumidity.description: Expose a linked Humidity tile (populated on units that report humidity). Uncheck to remove it.
